changes.description: Preview says how the points fall: how many land in a polygon, how many in none, how many with no usable location, and how many fall in more than one -- the last being the number a reader must not add up. The boundary setting above it changes the count.

evidence.note: Synthetic numerical contracts and pinned source regression cases; no independent scientific certification. 0.4.0: three points against two overlapping polygons, one in each, one in both and one in neither, with the overlap named.
